page.layout: One page of text, single column, with title block at top centred and a dedication body below; no marginal notes. Faint show-through text from the reverse page is visible and is not transcribed. Signature A 2 at foot.

main_text.head: ILLVSTRIBVS ORDINIBVS REGIONVM FOEDERATARVM QVÆ SVNT IN BELGIO, FRANCISCVS IVNIVS S. P.
main_text.p: VVM in has regiones vestras, Illustres Ordines, & in hanc florentem Academiam pedem primum intulissem, incredibili me dolore affecit hominis cuiusdam importunitas rerum nouarum in Ecclesia & re vestra publica studiosi, qui libellum à se conscriptum De Christi seruatoris efficacitate in omnibus & singulis hominibus, quatenus homines sunt, in hoc ipso tractu typis mandari curauerat.

page.notes: The large woodcut initial "O" opening the body text is joined to the word "VVM" as "OVVM" (Ouum is not implied; printed as a decorated O followed by VVM, transcribed as printed). The catchword "Plu-" is at the lower right. Line "intulissem,incredibili me" and similar spacing are as printed. Words in the faint show-through from the reverse page were excluded. The printed signature "A 2" is given as a gathering mark.
